Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.manager

Class OutputManager

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.manager.OutputManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
processing.core.PConstants
public class OutputManager extends Object implements processing.core.PConstants
Coordinates external-output routing and delegates publication to concrete backends.

NDI, Syphon, and Spout own their native resources and lifecycle independently. This manager retains the public routing API, resolves logical ViewType selections, and supplies completed FrameViews targets without implementing backend details.
